why: Long-term seasonal campground that sells no nights (read 2026-11-19): Tourism Saskatchewan listing 2790 (tourismsaskatchewan.com/listings/2790/cactus-blume-campground, search snippet; the page itself now returns 'No data found') calls it 'a long-term seasonal campground with 166 established full-service sites', privately operated, open mid-May to mid-Oct, contact by phone/Gmail only; Gov. of Saskatchewan release 2015-10-20 (saskatchewan.ca .../2015/october/20/sask-landing-investment) announced Cactus Blume Campground Ltd.'s 'long-term, full-service, seasonal campground' with 'the ability to remain in the same site, year over year'; a 2026-04-26 park review (acrockofschmidt.com/2026/04/26/saskatchewan-landing-provincial-park-review/) gives '166 seasonal campsites' and 'No idea how you'd learn more about getting a seasonal site here'. No operator website, booking engine or posted nightly rate found; the park's Campspot listing (sk-landing) is Glamping Resorts' canvas tents, not this campground. Fails long-stay test 2 (no nights for sale) and test 4 (0 of 166 sites nightly).
name: Cactus Blume Campground
flags: Not in campgrounds.json by name (Cactus/Blume/Bloom); the nearest Saskatchewan Landing entries are 9205, 15716 and 15717 (the provincial loops).
Operator now trades as 'Cactus Blume Campground (2019) Ltd' (Tourism Saskatchewan listing title); listing 2790 no longer returns data on tourismsaskatchewan.com as of 2026-11-19.
www.campspot.com was not fetched (refuses); its sk-landing listing was identified from a search snippet only.
